message.content:
The screen shows the Clipper app with a clipboard service started and instructions. To copy the text "john.doe@example.com" to the clipboard, I need to paste it into the clipboard. The clipboard can be accessed via the adshell command "am broadcast -a clipper.set -e text 'john.doe@example.com'". I should open the clipboard first by running this command.


do(action="Launch", app="adshell")
